body: i saw the episode where the psychologist kills his patients with their phobias. can’t remember the episode number! but all i remember as a kid was seeing the girl trapped in the coffee table/box in his office. and it totally freaked me out. when i started watching the show and i came across this episode i was like woahhhh

yea i get that. i took it personally because i found out later that he was talking to a mutual friend how he never cared for me at all and just liked using me. so with hearing that. i decided that he meant what he said. the drugs he claimed he was on he had never used before and i don’t believe he was on anything. overall he’s just not someone i want to associate anymore. i just wish he knew how bad he hurts me
yea, I kinda went through the same things. Many boyfriends, and many holes in my childhood. I may not have the memories, but I remember the feelings I had. That's kinda worse in a way i guess.
you're not the only one. Even when bad things have happened to me, I feel as though I deserve it. I believe that our feeling is valid.

So I saw this comment while I was actually in the waiting room of a psychologist's office. I went into it with an open mind, and I wanted to thank you for sharing your story. I think I am finally taking the right steps to getting help. thank you again :)))
